item.title: Prominence Energy Kicks Off Field Work in PEL 803 with Geochemical Survey for Natural Hydrogen
item.description: Prominence Energy (ASX: PRM) has initiated its first field exploration for natural hydrogen and helium with a geochemical survey in South Australia's PEL 803.

item.title: Nanoveu Secures Exclusive Drone Swarm IP License, Boosts Endurance in Trials
item.description: Nanoveu (ASX: NVU) has secured exclusive evaluation rights for four autonomous drone swarm localisation and formation-control inventions from NTU Singapore.

item.title: Lunnon Metals Hits High-Grade Gold at Lady Herial, Mining Underway
item.description: Lunnon Metals starts mining at Lady Herial after high-grade hits, including 13m at 5.70 g/t Au, signaling pit extension and near-term cash flow.

item.title: Black Bear Minerals Confirms Standing of Permits for Shafter Silver Project Restart
item.description: Black Bear Minerals ASX:BKB confirms key Shafter permits active and in good standing, signalling restart and reduced development risk for silver project

item.title: Aumake Seals A$10 Million Global Distribution Deal with EZZ Life Sciences
item.description: Aumake (ASX: AUK) has announced a significant four-year exclusive global distribution agreement with EZZ Life Sciences, a deal valued at a minimum of A$10m.

item.title: Botanix Pharmaceuticals Secures A$45 Million Capital Raise to Fund API Purchases and Supply Chain Diversification
item.description: Botanix secures A$45m to buy APIs and diversify supply; new shares A$0.06 at 45.5% discount; Sofdra posts Q2 FY26 A$9.1m revenue, 24% QoQ rise.

item.title: Cosmos Exploration's EAU Lithium inks Bolivia YLB negotiation deal for lithium production framework
item.description: Cosmos Exploration advances Bolivia lithium push as EAU Lithium and YLB sign a non-binding framework to explore Vulcan Energy's DLE tech; funding risk looms.

item.title: Viridis Mining and Minerals Strengthens Resource Confidence with Drilling at Colossus Project
item.description: Viridis Mining reports TREO uplift from Colossus rare-earth drilling, boosting feed grades and economics ahead of 2026 feasibility.

item.title: Resolution Minerals Reports New Gold-Tungsten Assays from Drilling at Golden Gate North
item.description: Resolution Minerals reports new gold-tungsten assays at Golden Gate North; drilling indicates open-ended gold system, with maiden resource planned in 2026.

item.title: Alligator Energy Prepares for Field Recovery Trials after Commissioning of Samphire Uranium Pilot Plant
item.description: Alligator Energy (ASX: AGE) completes Samphire uranium pilot plant commissioning on schedule; energise plant and begin 4-month field recovery trials.
